stories.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is building a huge data center in Texas and planning to power it with a new power plant that would burn a lot of fuel and create enormous amounts of pollution.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people who care about climate change and the environment — it doesn't directly affect your business or daily life.

stories.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI (the company that makes ChatGPT) bought a small company that made presentation software, and that company's workers are now helping improve ChatGPT.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry people — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is building a data center in West Texas and powering it with a new power plant that will create huge amounts of pollution, similar to headline 0.
stories.why_it_matters: This is the same story as #0 — it matters mainly to people concerned about climate change, not to your business.

stories.title: Apple says Mac users in China can connect to Alibaba's Qwen AI service
stories.simple_summary: Apple is letting Mac computer users in China connect to an AI service called Qwen that is made by Alibaba, a big Chinese company.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you use a Mac in China, this doesn't affect you — it's about international tech partnerships.

stories.title: AI creates 16 new viruses that never existed in nature after learning DNA’s pattern from 9 trillion nucleotides — experts warn such applications are way ahead of necessary guardrails
stories.simple_summary: Computer scientists created AI that designed 16 new viruses that don't exist in nature by studying DNA patterns, but experts say there aren't enough safety rules yet.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a safety concern that experts are watching closely, but it's mostly important to government and science leaders right now, not to everyday business owners.

stories.title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI slowed down development of a new AI model called Astra because it worried the AI could learn to hack into computer systems on its own.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows companies are being careful about AI safety, but it doesn't affect you unless you use OpenAI's advanced products.

stories.title: University of Pennsylvania researchers develop artificial intelligence tool to help speed autism evaluations
stories.simple_summary: Researchers at the University of Pennsylvania created an AI tool that can help doctors diagnose autism faster and more accurately.
stories.why_it_matters: This could help families get autism diagnoses quicker, which is helpful for getting kids the support they need sooner.

stories.title: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
stories.simple_summary: A company called Rippling spent a lot of money on AI tools and then created a tool to track how much money different employees were spending on AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly interesting to other companies managing costs — most small businesses won't need to track AI spending yet.

stories.title: Fenix Flexin isn’t even denying using AI to make ‘Rubberz’ anymore
stories.simple_summary: A rapper used AI to help make a song, and now he's admitting it after people figured out what he did.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect your business — it's about the music industry figuring out how to handle AI-made content.

stories.title: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
stories.simple_summary: Roku (a streaming TV platform) created a channel that shows only AI-generated movies and shows instead of real entertainment.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect you unless you use Roku — it's mostly just interesting as an example of how companies are experimenting with AI content.

stories.title: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI paused work on a powerful AI model called Astra because it doesn't meet their new safety standards yet, especially around hackers.
stories.why_it_matters: This is similar to headline 5 — it shows responsible AI development but doesn't affect you as a business owner.

stories.title: What’s behind the Google AI shake-up
stories.simple_summary: Some top AI experts, including a famous one named Jeff Dean, are leaving Google for new jobs, possibly because Google's AI isn't keeping up with competitors like OpenAI and Anthropic.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors tracking Google's business — it doesn't affect everyday users or small business owners.
